name: Kiri
source:
Kenichi’s exclusive maid.
She was originally an orphan, taken in and raised by Kenichi’s father.
It was her own choice to become a maid.
She is three years younger than the protagonist, though she does not look it at all.
She is dependable and capable, handling not only all kinds of household chores but most clerical work as well.
However, she has been frail since birth and is poor at physical labor.
Her personality is shy and introverted.
She feels a strong sense of gratitude and love toward the protagonist, and her devotion is almost blind.
She places the utmost importance on “existing as her master wishes.”
